validation.scope: The actual three-frontier identity, ordinary root, signed frontier payment and positive actual selected/rounded densities are fully accepted. Their original successful outputs and complete inventories are locally verified. Common physical Q family admission and identical-coefficient PP are still open.

source_scope.obligation: Rounded exact coprime mean and full-modulus elementary corrections
source_scope.identity: For every row, rowExactMean equals card(chenPrimePrefix N) times the signed rounded reciprocal-totient sum minus rowSignedPrime. Its denominator and modulus-prime numerator use fullModulus t k = (t.1*t.2)*k, including both marked primes.
source_scope.cost: The absolute value of the sum of the signed modulus-prime and centre corrections is bounded by correctionCost. Only nonzero roundedRho terms incur a cost. Different ordered pair labels preserve their multiplicity.
source_scope.finite_estimate: With N >= 1, pair reciprocal-totient mass at most H and fullModulus t k < N^(599/1000) at each nonzero coefficient, correctionCost <= (2H/log 2) * N^(599/1000) * log N.
source_scope.eventual_payment: For every eta > 0, the accepted original pair harmonic bound supplies a threshold before all epsilon, tau and policies. Under the displayed full-modulus cap, correctionCost <= eta * singularNormalization N.
source_scope.accuracy: The bound pays the combined elementary loss at the count scale. The sharp logarithmic physical-coefficient estimate and smoothed endpoint distribution are separate manuscript statements.

source_scope.obligation: Same-parameter lower bound for the original U5 count
source_scope.quantifiers: For each mesh and kappa, eta, epsilonMax > 0, choose 0 < epsilon < min(1/8, epsilonMax, 1/272), tau0 > 0 and N0 >= 2. For all even N >= N0, every PairRange R, every CandidateBank mesh and 0 < tau <= tau0, take P = selectedPolicy R bank (1/1000) false N.
source_scope.inequality: fullProjectedMainSum N P - card(chenPrimePrefix N) * (kappa * singularSeries N / log N) + sum_{t in pairSupport N} rowSignedPrimitive N epsilon tau (P t) t - eta * singularNormalization N <= currentChenUpsilon5 N.
source_scope.joint_conclusions: The same witnesses also give correctionCost N epsilon tau P <= eta * singularNormalization N and the strict full-modulus cap on every nonzero roundedRho. The prior pair-density reserve supplies the cap internally. The density replacement charges the prime-prefix cardinality times its row-normalization loss.
source_scope.coefficient: rowSignedPrimitive uses roundedRho N epsilon tau (P t) and retains its sign. fullProjectedMainSum uses fullDensity of the original selected policy and enters through the one-sided density reserve.

source_scope.obligation: Ordinary Rosser prefix and incoming-candidate admission for the actual U5 warm trace
source_scope.quantifiers: Every original pair t, N >= 2, receiver R, bank, rational buffer b <= 1/1000, and actual rough-prime subword; the current prefix must be accepted. The first result does not require a next candidate.
source_scope.prefix: At Q(H)=N^(incoming(H).cap)/(t.1*t.2), derive cutoff N < Q(H) and complete ordinary lower Rosser prefix admissibility, including empty and terminal histories.
source_scope.next_gate: For an available next smaller prime q, warm admission at incoming(H) is equivalent to the ordinary parity Rosser policy at that same Q(H); no acceptance of q is assumed.
source_scope.boundary: The subsequent accepted three-frontier group identifies the literal fullDensity. The accepted residual-payment group pays its signed changes and proves positive selected and rounded pair densities.

source_scope.identity: Literal selected fullDensity equals the ordinary lower root plus the exact signed changes at actual selected depths 1, 2 and 3, with complete history products and incoming/parent levels, including terminal states.

source_scope.obligation: Uniform signed changed-frontier payment and positive actual density
source_scope.quantifiers: Fix PairRange R. A positive constant and common large-target threshold precede all original pair labels, meshes, banks and rational buffers in [0,1/1000].
source_scope.method: Upper cube reduction covers residual ratios down to one. The actual depth-two lower residual has ratio at least two. Only cap-changing histories incur approximation error; their original list-occurrence weights have a uniform receiver-window bound. Three losses spend half the ordinary-root lower bound.

source_scope.obligation: Positive signed rounded density with the same physical cap
source_scope.quantifiers: After R, choose c>0 before mesh and epsilonMax. Then one epsilon, tau0 and N0 gives the literal signed double roundedRho/fullModulus-totient lower bound c*C_N/log N and fullModulus<N^(599/1000) for all subsequent even targets, candidate banks and 0<tau<=tau0.
source_scope.boundary: This is existential positive density. It does not evaluate the enhanced numerical constant or bound the signed primitive discrepancy.

remaining.gap: The actual original selected row, complete pair carrier and same-parameter rounded pair density now have unconditional positive lower constants. These constants do not by themselves identify the enhanced h248 certificate or establish positivity for every filtered query family.
